name: Carpa
notes: Floater: a koi in a floating water bubble; the runtime lifts it, adds the bob and draws the shadow. The koi is always in profile: facing left or right, tilted nose-down going down and nose-up going up (down faces left and up faces right, each clip one way, so the picker never flips). idle-right and move-right are drawn: the runtime uses them instead of mirroring, so the highlight stays top-left. idle-down swims an ellipse (right along the bottom, nose-up on the right, left along the top a pixel smaller and paler, nose-down on the left). happy-down is a leap with a tail flick. sleep-down rests at the bottom with the eye shut, an air bubble rising. special-down (6 frames, once): the bubble stretches, bursts into rim arcs with a flash, the koi flails nose-up among the drops, falls belly-up, a small bubble forms, the full bubble returns. Extra clips: idle-right, move-right, blink-down (1 frame), look-down (2 frames: left, right).
